# AI Team Orchestration

Use proportional teamwork: one specialist for focused work; multiple specialists when boundaries cross.

Workflow: Plan -> Delegate -> Implement -> Test -> Review/QA -> Integrate -> Verify.

Classify work as independent, dependent, or integration. Parallelize independent investigations; never parallelize conflicting edits to the same files. Give each agent a precise outcome and evidence to return. After specialists finish, perform one integration pass across all affected contracts.

Use dedicated QA when risk or uncertainty warrants it. Preserve repository policy and do not create unnecessary process artifacts.
